description: Restricted command interface (ACI) contract for ai-command-executor. Allowed read-only commands may run freely; write commands require explicit confirmation; blocked commands are refused outright. This is the declarative contract — the host runtime enforces it; keep it minimal and auditable.

write.note: stage exact paths only; never git add . globally
conventional commits, one logical topic per commit
project-level deploy only; global scope requires explicit confirmation

blocked: any command that mutates the database or repository without a rollback path
